Estimates per item (as served):
- Coffee with milk (latte, about 300 ml): 120 kcal, 7 g protein, 10 g carbs, 6 g fat.
- Berries (about 150 g strawberries and blueberries): 70 kcal, 1 g protein, 17 g carbs, 0.5 g fat.
- Yogurt cup (about 150 g, sweetened): 150 kcal, 6 g protein, 22 g carbs, 4 g fat.
- Eggs (2 eggs plus an extra piece of white, fried with little fat): 170 kcal, 14 g protein, 1 g carbs, 12 g fat.

Total served is about 510 kcal, which I rounded to 500. I assumed nothing is left over, so eaten equals served.
